factions.name: CJNG
factions.head: o_cjng
factions.description: From Jalisco. Better trained and equipped, fewer men on offer. Wants plazas and routes: a foothold in Sinaloa. Will come for you if you grow weak.

factions.name: Cártel del Golfo
factions.head: o_cdg
factions.description: From Tamaulipas. More men, cheaper, rougher. Wants cash and the eastern routes. More purely mercenary.
